{{Quote|It is time. I will send my destroyer to the fringe systems, and they will be mine before anyone is the wiser.|Darth Vengean|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Karastace Gonn]] during the final days of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Darth Vengean]] of the [[Dark Council]] '''conquered''' the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] on the fringes of the Empire and the Republic in order to convince the Council that it was time for a [[Galactic War|return to war]].
